title: Create Heating and Cooling Fingerübung Assignment
description: Create a complete bilingual heating and cooling assignment from supplied slide content using the assignment print class and return the German PDF.
summary: Created and delivered a four-page German Heating + Cooling assignment PDF, with bilingual course sources, build declarations and independent numerical fixtures. Both actual assignment-class PDFs compile and pass visual review; 156 course/integration tests pass. Standard target planning was stopped by host memory, so native target publication remains unverified; registered direct compiler succeeded. See completion.md. Temporary generated outputs removed.
